songs.title: Pop! Goes the Weasel
songs.body:
[Verse]
All around the [G]mulberry bush
The [D]monkey chased the [G]weasel
The monkey thought 'twas all in fun
[D]Pop! goes the [G]weasel

songs.title: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
songs.body:
[Verse]
Here we go round the [G]mulberry bush
The [D]mulberry bush, the [G]mulberry bush
Here we go round the mulberry bush
[D]So early in the [G]morning

songs.title: He's Got the Whole World in His Hands
songs.body:
[Verse]
He's got the whole world [G]in His hands
He's got the whole world [D]in His hands
He's got the whole world [G]in His hands
He's got the whole world [D]in His [G]hands

songs.title: Shall We Gather at the River
songs.body:
[Chorus]
Yes, we'll [C]gather at the river
The beautiful, the beautiful [G]river
Gather with the saints at the [C]river
That flows by the throne of [G]God

songs.title: Holy, Holy, Holy
songs.body:
[Verse]
[D]Holy, holy, holy! [G]Lord God Al[D]mighty
[A]Early in the morning our song shall rise to [D]Thee

songs.title: Rock of Ages
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Rock of Ages, [C]cleft for [G]me
[D]Let me hide my[G]self in Thee

songs.title: Nearer, My God, to Thee
songs.source: Sarah Flower Adams (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Nearer, my God, to Thee
Nearer to [C]Thee
[G]E'en though it be a cross
That [D]raiseth [G]me

songs.title: Abide with Me
songs.source: Henry Francis Lyte (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
A[G]bide with me; fast falls the eventide
The darkness [D]deepens; Lord, with me a[G]bide

songs.title: Jesus Loves Me
songs.source: Anna Bartlett Warner (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Jesus loves me, this I know
[C]For the Bible [G]tells me so
Little ones to Him belong
They are [D]weak but He is [G]strong

songs.title: Daisy Bell
songs.body:
[Chorus]
[G]Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer, do
[D]I'm half crazy all for the love of you

songs.title: Cotton-Eyed Joe
songs.body:
[Verse]
[A]Where did you come from, where did you go?
Where did you come from, Cotton-Eyed [E]Joe?

songs.title: Cripple Creek
songs.body:
[Verse]
Goin' up [G]Cripple Creek, goin' on a run
Goin' up Cripple Creek to have a little [D]fun

songs.title: In the Pines
songs.body:
[Verse]
[E]In the pines, in the pines, where the sun never shines
And you shiver when the cold wind [B7]blows

songs.title: Careless Love
songs.body:
[Verse]
[G]Love, oh love, oh careless love
[C]Love, oh love, oh careless [G]love

songs.title: Frankie and Johnny
songs.body:
[Verse]
[C]Frankie and Johnny were lovers
Oh Lordy, how they could [G]love

songs.title: John Hardy
songs.body:
[Verse]
[A]John Hardy was a desperate little man
He carried two guns every [E]day

songs.title: Nine Pound Hammer
songs.body:
[Verse]
This [G]nine pound hammer is a little too heavy
For my [C]size, honey, for my [G]size

songs.title: For He's a Jolly Good Fellow
songs.body:
[Verse]
For [G]he's a jolly good fellow
For [D]he's a jolly good [G]fellow
For [C]he's a jolly good [G]fellow
Which [D]nobody can [G]deny

songs.title: Oh Christmas Tree
songs.body:
[Verse]
Oh [G]Christmas tree, oh Christmas tree
How [D]lovely are your [G]branches

songs.title: O Holy Night
songs.source: Adolphe Adam / Placide Cappeau (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse]
O [C]holy night, the [F]stars are brightly [C]shining
It is the night of the [G]dear Savior's [C]birth

songs.title: The Holly and the Ivy
songs.body:
[Verse]
The [G]holly and the ivy
When they are both full [D]grown
Of [G]all the trees that are in the wood
The [D]holly bears the [G]crown
